ruleDefinitions.name: Cloudflared Portable Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of the "cloudflared" binary from a non standard location.

sequences.query: process_path = RGX("\\\\cloudflared\\\.exe$") AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\cloudflared\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\cloudflared\\\\.*")))
